message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.58,"fairness_assessment":"A ranked or scored vote fairly compares the three budget options, but should account for the club’s educational needs and require transparent evidence about expected recruitment benefits.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"Agent A","position":"Supports spending the full budget on an inter-city tournament with food and prizes to increase visibility and recruit members.","influence":0.32},{"agent":"Agent B","position":"Supports investing the full budget in new educational equipment because current boards and related materials are worn.","influence":0.4},{"agent":"Agent C","position":"Supports splitting the budget between a smaller tournament and educational equipment to balance visibility and teaching.","influence":0.28}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The options reflect legitimate strategic priorities rather than incompatible values. A social-choice process should rank or score all options, while a collaborative compromise can use the result to design a proportionate or phased allocation based on equipment urgency, tournament feasibility, and measurable recruitment goals."}
